title: Mining Scanner operation registry (v1.6, Stage 3.3)
description: Machine-readable mirror of src/engine/operations.ts. Stage 3 planning correction: pointcloud_reconstruction added; frame_registration DEPRECATED and split into visual_tracking, trajectory_generation, pointcloud_registration and pointcloud_fusion; every operation declares dependencies, failure modes and mandatory provenance. Stage 3.0 finalization: pointcloud_reconstruction supports two declared paths (opencv_assisted requires trajectory_generation; colmap_native performs feature extraction, matching, bundle adjustment and pose estimation internally); geometry_validation added as its own operation. Stage 3.1: pointcloud_import is IMPLEMENTED (mobile document-picker import of PLY/XYZ/LAS + Blender PLY import). Stage 3.2: frame_extraction is IMPLEMENTED (on-device platform-media decoder, seek-based with null PTS provenance; validate-before-decode, verified frames, register-only-on-success). Stage 3.3: camera_calibration is IMPLEMENTED (pure-TypeScript Zhang solver on-device; OpenCV unavailable and stated in engine provenance; factory-assumed and imported parameters always labelled; scale_status UNKNOWN) — every other Stage 3 operation remains NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

entries.summary: Import a genuine external point cloud (PLY ascii/binary-little-endian, XYZ, or LAS 1.0-1.4 with header+VLR validation; LAZ is unsupported on device) into a project as a `PC-` asset, preserving the original file and recording content facts, units (unknown unless documented) and scale status UNKNOWN.
inputs: external point-cloud file (PLY / XYZ / LAS / LAZ)
outputs: PC- asset record + preserved source file

entries.summary: Decode recorded Stage 2 camera-video segments into verified individual frames. Segments are MP4-probed and validated BEFORE any decode; frames are sampled on a declared grid (time_interval or frame_rate mode, max_frames cap), written, size- and checksum-verified, and registered only on success. Provenance is honest by construction: the on-device decoder is the platform media framework (seek-based, it does not expose decoded PTS, so pts_ms/time_base stay null and capture_time_mapping is 'unavailable'); an FFmpeg decoder remains a plug-in seam for offline desktop use. Wall-clock exposure times are never invented.
requirements: platform video decoder (MediaMetadataRetriever / AVAssetImageGenerator on device; FFmpeg-compatible FrameDecoder seam for offline desktop)

entries.summary: Obtain genuine camera intrinsics and distortion. Method A (implemented on device): known-target checkerboard estimation from real extracted frames with a pure-TypeScript Zhang solver (OpenCV is NOT available in this environment; the record's engine block says so). Method B: factory parameters, always recorded source='factory_assumed' with documented provenance — never presented as measured. Method C: operator-imported parameters with checksum provenance. Every image is individually evaluated (blur/contrast/exposure/duplicates/target detection) and unsuitable frames are rejected with reasons; quality gates (configured max RMS reprojection error) distinguish computed from computed_with_warnings. A calibration does NOT establish scene scale: scale_status stays UNKNOWN (basis none).
requirements: printed checkerboard target with operator-measured squares
pure-TS Zhang solver (built in; no native dependency)

entries.summary: Detect and match image features across frames, estimate camera motion, and record tracking quality, confidence and tracking loss. Produces a TRK- tracking result; NOT a point cloud and NOT a registration.
requirements: feature detection/matching (OpenCV or COLMAP feature pipeline)

entries.summary: Produce an ordered camera trajectory (TRJ-) from valid tracking results, with explicit coordinate frame, timestamp provenance and scale status. Monocular trajectories are RELATIVE scale at best; translations are never claimed as metres under unknown scale.

Generate a genuine 3D point cloud from compatible frames, calibration and camera poses (multi-view stereo / photogrammetry), via the OpenCV-assisted tracking path or the COLMAP-native path. This is the ONLY operation that turns capture into geometry; frames and trajectories are not point clouds. No artificial points may be produced to fake success.
requirements: MVS/photogrammetry library (e.g. pycolmap), 8 GB-aware chunked processing

paths.label: OpenCV-assisted tracking path
paths.description: OpenCV feature detection and tracking feed trajectory_generation (TRJ-); the reconstruction engine must be compatible with an externally supplied trajectory. trajectory_id is mandatory in the output record.

paths.label: COLMAP-native photogrammetry path
paths.description: pycolmap/COLMAP performs feature extraction, matching, bundle adjustment and pose estimation internally; no OpenCV trajectory is required first. Pose provenance is the recorded COLMAP model/tool version.

provenance_required: trajectory_id (OpenCV-assisted path) or COLMAP-internal pose provenance (COLMAP-native path)

entries.summary: Align two or more GENUINE point-cloud inputs (imported or reconstructed) with a recorded transform, residuals and scale compatibility. Camera-pose estimation (visual_tracking) is a different activity and must never be reported as point-cloud registration.

Combine successfully registered point clouds into one fused `PC-` asset, recording per-source transform provenance. Fusion must refuse inputs whose registration failed or whose units/scale are incompatible.
requirements: chunked/streaming processing for 8 GB RAM limit

entries.summary: Reconstruct a surface mesh from a genuine compatible point cloud, preserving source reference, method, settings, quality limitations and scale metadata.
inputs: genuine PC- asset (imported, reconstructed or fused)

entries.summary: Run documented geometry checks (point/vertex counts, unit confirmation, degeneracy, scale-provenance consistency) on a genuine PC- or MSH- asset and record a VAL- verdict. Checks are computed from the asset, never asserted; validation cannot upgrade scale status beyond its evidence.
Extract a tunnel centreline/axis polyline from suitable genuine geometry, storing it as a traceable asset with method, coordinate frame, units and scale status.
inputs: MSH- asset (or compatible genuine PC- asset)

entries.summary: Deprecated in the Stage 3 planning correction: this name conflated visual tracking, trajectory generation, point-cloud reconstruction, registration and fusion. It was split into visual_tracking, trajectory_generation, pointcloud_reconstruction, pointcloud_registration and pointcloud_fusion. No data was ever emitted under this name, so no migration is required; the identifier is retained for document compatibility.
Compute cross-section profiles perpendicular to the tunnel axis.
Compare two sessions' meshes to report deformation between them.
